en:
It would appear we all have gathered...
But it seems there are less and less of us.

Less friends mean it that much harder
to solve mystery.

Well, don't worry. I'm sure you've gotten a
little smarter by now, Gonta.
Y-Yeah...Gonta do his best to help...

I'd want you to graduate from super-idiot level
to at least Kaito-idiot level.
Hey! What's that supposed to mean!?
Ah, more importantly...are you okay, Kaito?

Yeah...I'm feeling better now.
But wow, Maki Roll sure does pack a punch.
...It's your fault.

You don't need to worry about our dwindling
numbers. Only dipshits have died so far.

I know it's a tall order but try to use your
brains this time so I don't have to use mine!

These golden brain cells of mine are a gift
to the entire world!

It's as though every time you open 
your mouth, you become less likable.

Atua, please...
Please lend us your power.
...It may be difficult for us to rely on Atua.

Considering what happened to Angie, whom
Atua loved most of all...

She shouldn't have relied on Atua in the
first place.

But seriously, it's kinda funny seeing a robot
believe in god, especially <CLT=cltSTRONG>Atua<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
S-So what...? Robots can believe in god.

Actually...before I even met Angie, I had
a similar experience.
...Hearing voices, I mean.

You might call it an inner voice... It tells me
what to do whenever I'm in trou—

How long are you going to say that for?
Atua and ghosts don't matter right now.

Yeah, the trial this time is gonna be rough.
We got caught in Monokuma's trap.
His trap?

He probably made the 4th floor so scary on
purpose to prevent me from investigating.
No, he didn't.
Yeah...there's no way.
Shuichi...say something.
Wh-What should I say?

This trial is gonna be rough...
Since I couldn't do any investigating...
Gonta do his best to help!
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!

I respected Angie and Tenko so much,
since the moment we met!

Shut up! Nothing's gonna be solved 
by crying about it!
Besides...that was a lie, wasn't it?

Yup! You guys have me figured out already,
so there's no point in keeping up the act.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi...never changes, no matter
what situation he's in.

Why did the seance fail...?
I never did figure out why...

<CLT=cltMIND>I see he's still more interested
in that than the case.

It's true...though I do not know if it can
be attributed to god per se...

I can hear an <CLT=cltSTRONG>inner voice<CLT=cltNORMAL> guiding me when
I don't know what to do.

I can't explain why, but I believe that voice
will lead me to hope as long as I listen to it.

Shut up! Why the fuck is a robot talkin' about
god anyway? It's unseemly!

That <CLT=cltSTRONG>inner voice<CLT=cltNORMAL> is probably just a radio or
something. Like in taxis and stuff.
...It was unwise of me to confide in you all.

Atua and ghosts don't matter right now.
The culprit is...among us.
Hmm... So in the end, the culprit really was...

N-No, it's nothing... We can talk about it 
once the trial starts.

Try usin' your brain so I don't have to! My
golden brain cells are a gift to the entire world!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*rumble rumble rumble!*

<CLT=cltMIND>As usual, we walked toward the
elevator in silence.

<CLT=cltMIND>As soon as we remaining
survivors stepped aboard...
<CLT=cltMIND>we descended.

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps because there were fewer of us,
the elevator seemed to move faster.

<CLT=cltMIND>And so we fell, faster and faster,
downward into the black.
